newsitem.title: USA: Midwest Express Q1 net up on higher yield.
newsitem.headline: Midwest Express Q1 net up on higher yield.

text.p: Midwest Express Holdings Inc said Wednesday continued strong revenue yield and passenger volume helped the company's earnings rise by 49 percent in the first quarter ended March 31.
The holding company for Midwest Express Airlines posted net income of $4.2 million, or $0.67 a share, versus $2.8 million, or $0.44, in the same period last year.
Revenues climbed to $79.9 million from $66.6 million in the first quarter of 1996.
Midwest Express said revenue yield rose 10 percent from last year and passenger traffic was up seven percent on a 12-percent capacity increase.
The company's shares were up 3/4 Wednesday at 38-7/8.
